name: tsa_getRedemptionDetail
description: Returns individual redeemed orders (worker name, restaurant, meal, times), newest date first, optionally for one restaurant. NULL @restaurantId returns every restaurant (admin view); the restaurant portal passes its own id. Scope is enforced only by the caller. Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'getRedemptionDetail' to [TSA].[tsa_getRedemptionDetail]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

parameters.name: restaurantId
parameters.description: Optional restaurant filter. Default NULL = all restaurants.

rowsets.name: Redemptions
rowsets.description: Zero or more rows ordered by date DESC, redeemedAt DESC.

columns.name: redeemedAt
columns.description: Style-127 text of a DATETIME2 UTC value, no 'Z'.

codeSmells.issue: SP body not wrapped in TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Read procedure with no TRY/CATCH: any runtime error (timeout, deadlock) becomes an unlogged raw 500 from the shim.

codeSmells.issue: Every worker's redemptions readable without a key
codeSmells.detail: The shim lets a GET name any procedure with no X-Api-Key; GET /api/TsaApi?queryType=getRedemptionDetail returns every worker's name and meal history across all restaurants. The fix is in TsaApi.cs (allowlist GET procedures), not in this SP.
No date window or paging; the whole redemption history is returned on every call.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
